summary: Guest query API path: real answer, cost tracked as a guest row in queries, no session/budget writes
description: Depends on the guest primitive + migration. Dedicated POST /api/query/guest sharing retrieval+prompt+stream helpers with /api/query (extract shared machinery). Pin free-tier defaults: DEFAULT_CURATED_SLUG model, DEFAULT_VOICE (scholar), default retrieval scope — full corpus retrieval + citations, real streamed answer (must NOT feel like a demo). Enforce guest-token one-shot + guest:<ip> throttle up front (429 when exhausted). Compute cost from the usage chunk exactly like the authed path (computeCost), then INSERT ONE row into queries with user_id=NULL, session_id=NULL, tier_used='guest', guest_ip, ip_name, guest_token_hash, plus query/response/tokens/cost_usd. Do NOT call reserveBudget/finalizeBudget, do NOT create a users or sessions row. Optional follow-up backstop: global daily guest-spend cap via SUM(cost_usd) WHERE tier_used='guest' today.

resolution.note: New POST /api/query/guest reuses buildAnswerStream; free-tier pins (DEFAULT_PREFERENCES + DEFAULT_VOICE + DEFAULT_CURATED_SLUG); consumeGuestQuery gate; persists queries row user_id/session_id NULL, tier_used='guest', cost+ip_name+guest_token_hash. Authed route refactored onto the same helper. Tests land in child 2d4bdd96.
